trap.label: might
trap.wrong: Try as you can, you will still be anchored.
trap.right: Try as you might, you will still be anchored.
trap.why: A estrutura fixa try as + sujeito + might aparece em concessivas; o aluno troca por can pela tradução “por mais que tente”.

mcq.q: “Try as you ___, you will be anchored.”

fix.wrong: Much as we like to think rational, we are biased.
fix.right: Much as we like to think we are rational, we are biased.

fix.wrong: The first number gives rise a high price.
fix.right: The first number gives rise to a high price.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com Much as: “Although we like to think we are rational, we are biased.”
rewrite.answer: Much as we like to think we are rational, we are biased.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com give rise to: “The first number causes a high price.”
rewrite.answer: The first number gives rise to a high price.
